evidence: UiPropSchema public min/max Option<f64> permits min=Some(NaN), max=None. validate_schema_defaults checks bounds only when both Some; register therefore accepts this descriptor. apply_numeric_drag with no dynamic min/max calls clamp_component_numeric_value; optional_numeric_setting falls back to schema_min and clamp_numeric invokes f64::clamp with NaN lower bound, causing panic.
impact_or_question: A registered custom numeric descriptor with a single NaN boundary can panic on a valid DragDelta event rather than return UiComponentEventError.
next_action: Validate finiteness of each present boundary before paired-order validation; add one-sided min/max NaN contract cases and a non-panicking numeric event case.
